ruling.recommended_action: Reverse the $6.61 cancellation fee and issue the rider a voucher refund; no driver account action — driver never tapped "I'm Here", so this is not a mis-tap case.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the only chat is a pickup-timing exchange (F7, F8) and a bland driver statement (F10); nothing threatening, abusive, sexual or dangerous-driving related → safety_concern = none, no escalation.

Route under NS-0: cancelled_by = rider, so this is an immediate (non-advanced) booking and NS-4 governs. F2 shows the rider cancelled 2 min 30 s after matching at 18:23:00 — within the 3-minute grace window (≤ 3:00). Under NS-4, "All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable", so the $6.61 in F2/F5 is not chargeable. The driver's non-arrival (F1: closest approach 1816 m, never within 200 m; F3 driver_arrived_at null; F4 no "I'm Here" tap and no platform auto-arrival) reinforces that no wait-based fee could arise; NS-1 is therefore not available to justify the fee, and the driver's written claim that he "was on his way" (F10) does not create a chargeable event. NS-6 is inapplicable (no trip completed, no waiting-fee button). Slow traffic (F11) is a driver-side condition and does not extend the rider's free window; Ryde publishes no ETA-lateness waiver (NS-8, non-citable).

Amount: full refund of the fee actually charged, $6.61 (F5). Evidence is complete for every element (matching time, cancel time, cancel side, fee charged; F9 confirms a full timestamped chat record) → evidence_status = sufficient.

RD-6 / NS-2 account flags are not triggered: no RD-2 refund or RD-1 violation, and no "I'm Here" tap placed the driver outside the pickup radius (F4), so no abuse-of-button flag. Profiles (F14/F15) show no prior upheld disputes and are not used to decide anything.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-hoc statement that he was on his way is a claim, not a chargeable event; NS-1 requires a recorded arrival within 200 m plus continuous 3-minute wait, and F1/F3/F4 show neither. It also cannot override the system timeline (F2) on when the rider cancelled.
Slow traffic is a driver-side condition (speed band 4, 30-39 km/h, no incident per F12) and does not create a chargeable cancellation fee or extend the rider's free-cancellation window under NS-4.
